messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "multi-day, single-dose administration of 24 mg orally for HEC has not been studied"
set: ["multi-day, single-dose administration of 24 mg orally for HEC has not been studied", "oral administration recommended for MEC", "dosing schedule occurs after dose has been settled", "reduce dosage after adequate response has been reached", "if child has been prescribed the liquid form", "discard the pen if it has been frozen", "75 mg orally", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "5 mg has comparable effectiveness", "process continues until the desired diuretic effect has been obtained", "do not share pen with other people even if pen needle has been changed", "parenteral administration recommended", "no additional benefit has been demonstrated with doses above 7.5 mg/day", "administration of a second dose does not provide additional control of nausea and vomiting", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC", "some patients may not experience adequate analgesia for the first 24 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
